title: Computer control
description: Let the assistant see your screen to help you fix problems and work in Unity, Blender, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, VS Code… This version is VIEW-ONLY: the assistant takes screenshots and guides you; it never clicks or types.
enableHelp: Off by default. When on, the emergency stop hotkey is registered with Windows; the assistant can only see your screen after you also turn on "Allow screen viewing" in each session.
modeView: Current mode: VIEW-ONLY — screenshots and advice. Mouse/keyboard actions are not enabled in this version.

hotkey.label: Emergency stop
hotkey.failed: Could not register — another app is using this hotkey

screen.heading: Allow the assistant to see the screen
screen.help: This session only: turns off when the app restarts or on emergency stop. The assistant can take screenshots, read Unity/Blender logs and (with the sidecar) list windows and read UI trees; images and content are sent to Claude for analysis.
screen.toggleOn: Allow the assistant to see the screen

preview.help: The test capture is only shown here on your computer, not sent to Claude — so you can see what the assistant would see.

stop.done: Emergency stop: the assistant stopped viewing the screen and all running replies were stopped.

indicator: The assistant can see your screen · {{hotkey}} to stop

warning.title: Before enabling computer control
warning.lead: This is an experimental feature. Please read carefully before enabling it.
points: When you allow it, the assistant takes screenshots and sends them to Claude (counts toward your Claude plan). Screenshots may contain anything on screen — close windows with sensitive information (passwords, banking, private messages) first.
Every capture is logged with its image on your computer for 7 days so you can review it.
Press {{hotkey}} at any time (even in another app) to stop immediately: screen viewing is turned off and all running replies are stopped.
This version is view-only: the assistant does not click, type or open apps. Actions will only be enabled with a separate confirmation.
The assistant must never enter passwords or payment details for you.
warning.confirm: I have read and understand the points above.

errors.warning_required: Please read and accept the warning before enabling.
errors.hotkey_unavailable: Could not register the emergency stop hotkey {{hotkey}} (another app may be using it). The feature can only be enabled when the stop hotkey works.
errors.not_enabled: Enable computer control (and check the emergency stop hotkey) first.
errors.sidecar_not_installed: The Python sidecar is not installed.

sidecar.heading: Read windows & UI tree (Python sidecar)
sidecar.help: Lets the assistant list open windows and read the UI tree (button names, inputs, error messages) — more accurate than reading text from screenshots. Read-only, no actions. Reading Unity/Blender logs does not need this.
sidecar.size: Downloads about {{downloadMb}} MB (uv, Python 3.12, pywinauto) and uses about {{diskMb}} MB in the app data folder. Your existing Python is not touched.
sidecar.installingHint: This may take a few minutes depending on your connection. You can keep using the app meanwhile.
sidecar.checkOk: Working: read {{windows}} windows (Python {{python}}). The result is only shown here, not sent to Claude.
sidecar.removeHint: Deletes uv, Python and the downloaded libraries from the app data folder. The assistant can still take screenshots and read logs; reinstall to read the UI tree.

errors.network: Download failed — check your connection and click Try again. ({{message}})
errors.checksum: The downloaded file did not match its checksum and was discarded for safety. Try again later; if it keeps failing, tell the team.
